considerations: Vehicle access is available from two intersecting streets into a large paved parking lot that provides staging space on multiple sides of the building. Multiple vehicles occupy the lot. The structure is a two-story commercial building with a brown shingle roof and a covered front entry. The property sits on a corner lot with direct sidewalk access. An adjacent small structure is present in the front parking area. The site is located in a mixed commercial and residential area near other businesses, a school, and a church.
